column6: eMudhra emSign ECC Root CA - G3 removed from Mozilla NSS (compromised intermediates, Oct 2026)

column4: <venv>/bin/pip install --upgrade certifi   # run for each listed virtualenv/site-packages
Upgrade the JDK/JRE package (or remove the alias with: keytool -delete -alias <alias> -keystore <cacerts>)
Reissue the listed certificate from a CA that does not chain to eMudhra/emSign, deploy it, reload the service
If your distro has no update yet, remove the listed roots from your local trust store per your distro's docs.
